chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 499: The Godking's Gambit - A Trap for Ji Ning
chapter_meta_description: The Seamless Gate fears Ji Ning. To stop him, the Godking activates a secret weapon: Yu Wei. A trap is set in the Fifth World. Read the free translation of Chapter 499!
og_description: The leaders of the Seamless Gate fear Ji Ning's monstrous power. Their solution is to call upon the Godking, who activates a hidden pawn to spring a devastating trap.
twitter_description: The Godking activates the ultimate pawn, Yu Wei, to trap and kill the monstrous Ji Ning. The war for the Grand Xia enters a deadly new phase.

lore_anchors.definition: The supreme leader of the Seamless Gate, a being of unimaginable power who commands his forces from a dark dream-realm. His authority is absolute, and his strategic mind spans the entire cosmos.

Ji Ning's own master, a reclusive and supremely powerful Daofather, considered by the Godking to be one of the most dangerous beings in the Three Realms. His disciples include several other Daofathers.
A supreme divine ability beneath the True God level, trained by mastering nine cycles of body refinement. Its defensive power is legendary, making Ji Ning incredibly difficult to kill.
A power that naturally manifests at a Sword Immortal's blade when they fully master the Grand Dao of the Sword and seek its deeper essence.
A top-tier Immortal who has mastered a Grand Dao, representing a pinnacle of power within the Three Realms. The Fuhua Immortal is such a figure.
The peak combatants of the Three Realms below the level of Daofather. They are the primary agents used by the top powers in their long-running conflict.
